name: Hermes
description: Nous Research's Hermes Agent CLI, driven headlessly (hermes chat -q --format stream-json). One model, no questions: the clarify toolset is disabled because headless mode has no channel to answer it.

requires.image: glibc + node >= 20 + Python 3.11 with hermes-agent v2026.9.24: git clone --depth 1 --branch v2026.9.24 https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent into a Python 3.11 venv and pip install -e . (a plain pip install from git refuses by design), leaving the `hermes` binary on PATH

model.title: Orchestrator model
model.description: The only model this agent runs on, as <provider>/<model>. It must name a provider added in Settings, which the colony reaches through the mothership's provider gateway — the key stays host-side and the colony needs no provider egress. Nous Portal models (nous/…) are refused: Portal credits are a prepaid pool the gateway cannot account for. Empty is refused too: headless Hermes has no default to fall back on.
